text: In June 2020, the most-repeated thing we said was "justice in policing." 122 of us reached it on 2020-06-25, first spoken 2020-06-07 by Richard E. Neal. "justice in policing act" followed close behind, 120 of us, same peak day. Nancy Pelosi first said "george floyd justice in policing" on 2020-06-15; by 2020-06-25 that phrase had gathered 104 of us, and "george floyd justice in policing act" 103. The longer form, "the george floyd justice in policing," held 101 of us. Beneath that, "affordable care enhancement" collected 84 of us, first said by Nancy Pelosi on 2020-06-18, peaking 2020-06-29. We record that in this month our language converged on one bill's name, growing longer word by word as more of us adopted it, until more than a hundred of us were saying the same phrase on the same day.
